name: labs/florian-lapp__nesp-lib-py
title: New Era syringe pump (nesp-lib Pump)
intro: New Era syringe pump (nesp-lib Pump), adapted from florian-lapp/nesp-lib-py. It reads `model_number`, `firmware_version`, `status`, `running` and 2 more; sets `syringe_diameter_mm`, `pumping_direction`, `pumping_volume_ml`, `pumping_rate_ml_per_min` and 1 more; runs `run_pump`, `purge` and `stop_pump`. `run_pump`: start the pump with the configured direction, volume and rate (Pump.run without waiting); it returns after starting the pump, and the state reports whether it is running. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
